schema.name: reference_pack_index
schema.purpose: Byte-level and stream-level index of every file in the reference corpus at /Users/mac/Documents/photography-WORKFLOW-local/00-assets/drone-video-examples, plus the out-of-corpus source master the corpus's own sidecar names. Companion to data/reference_pack/editorial_style.json: that file records HOW the material is cut and graded, this one records WHAT the files physically are and how they relate. Every field traces to a command run against the bytes; nothing is a default.

toolchain.ffprobe: 8.1 at /opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe at measurement time. NOTE 2026-07-27: a homebrew x265 4.1->4.2 upgrade later broke the link set (dyld abort); brew reinstall ffmpeg restored it as 8.1.2. All measurements in this pack were made under 8.1.
toolchain.ffmpeg: 8.1 at /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg at measurement time (version recorded 2026-07-27; scdet/cropdetect/signalstats behaviour is version-dependent). Same relink note as ffprobe: now 8.1.2.
toolchain.hash: shasum -a 256, and re-verified by python3 hashlib.sha256 in this session
toolchain.python: system python3, stdlib only (json, csv, hashlib, math, os, datetime)
toolchain.unavailable: cv2, numpy, scenedetect, opentimelineio - no optical-flow capability in this environment, so any claim requiring it is marked UNVERIFIABLE IN-SESSION rather than guessed

confidence_vocabulary.measured: produced by a command run against the file's bytes in this session
confidence_vocabulary.inferred: deduced from measurements without direct observation of the causal step
confidence_vocabulary.unknown: neither measured nor deducible from what is present
confidence_vocabulary.UNVERIFIABLE IN-SESSION: requires a tool absent from this environment; recorded as an open claim, never as a fact

entry_contract.path: absolute path to the file as it exists on this machine
entry_contract.sha256: SHA-256 of the whole file, recomputed in this session (not carried forward)
entry_contract.mtime_utc: filesystem modification time, UTC, ISO-8601. Chronology only - mtime is not provenance
entry_contract.derived_from: the parent this file was produced from, as established by measurement
entry_contract.provenance_note: the evidence for role/derived_from, quoted from the analysis phase
entry_contract.provenance_measured_in_session: false throughout: the correlation/PSNR work behind provenance was done in an earlier phase and was not re-run here. The ffprobe, sha256, scdet and cropdetect figures WERE re-run here
entry_contract.container: format-level ffprobe facts; null for non-media
entry_contract.video: video-stream ffprobe facts including coded geometry, rate, and colour tagging; null for non-media
entry_contract.audio: audio presence and per-stream detail; detail is null when no audio stream exists
entry_contract.active_picture: cropdetect result - the picture area inside any baked-in bars. null where cropdetect was not run in this session
entry_contract.scene_analysis: scdet-derived hard-cut count and scene-score extremes; null for non-media
entry_contract.cross_reference: manifest.json claim vs measurement for the split clips; null otherwise
entry_contract.probe_artefacts: repo-relative paths to the raw ffprobe JSON and scdet CSV backing this entry
entry_contract.json: SIDECAR-ONLY (kind=sidecar_json entries, i.e. manifest.json itself): the parsed content of the sidecar, embedded verbatim so the index is self-contained.
entry_contract.not_media_reason: SIDECAR-ONLY (kind=sidecar_json entries): why this corpus file has no ffprobe fingerprint or scene-score fields - it is JSON, not media.

video_field_notes.coded_aspect_ratio: width:height of the CODED frame, reduced. It is not the aspect of the visible picture where bars are baked in - see active_picture
video_field_notes.colour: a null member means the tag is ABSENT from the stream, i.e. unspecified. It does not mean BT.709; assuming BT.709 for an absent tag is an inference, not a measurement
video_field_notes.bit_rate_bps: stream bit rate. The container-level rate differs slightly because it includes muxing overhead

scene_analysis_field_notes.hard_cut_threshold: 10.0 on scdet's 0-100 scale. Calibrated against a synthetic positive control (testsrc2->black->smptebars) whose genuine cuts scored 31.42 and 42.19
scene_analysis_field_notes.frames_at_or_above_5: a deliberately lax second threshold, reported so the zero result cannot be read as threshold-shopping
scene_analysis_field_notes.scene_score_max_excluding_frame1_warmup: scdet's first scored frame (t=0.033333 s) is a warm-up artefact because prev_mafd is still 0. In three of the split clips that artefact IS the global maximum, so the excluding-warm-up figure is the honest one
scene_analysis_field_notes.shot_count: 1 in every file. This is a positive finding, not a detection failure

cross_reference_field_notes.agrees: true only on exact frame agreement at 30 fps; a sub-frame delta is not rounded away
cross_reference_field_notes.sidecar_motion_type_status: always UNVERIFIABLE IN-SESSION - optical flow is not available here

role.master: the most upstream file present; everything else in its family descends from it
role.derivative: cut or transformed from a master that is present and identified
role.rendition: one of several exports of a parent timeline that is NOT present
role.unknown: not media, so the role vocabulary does not apply

provenance.known: a document in the corpus names the parent AND measurement confirms it
provenance.inferred: no document names the parent; the relationship rests on measurement alone

top_level_keys.corpus: what the indexed directory contains, and how it partitions
top_level_keys.source_master: the out-of-corpus file that manifest.json names as the source of the split family
top_level_keys.files: the 9 corpus entries, sidecar first then split family then vertical renditions
top_level_keys.families: the two provably independent groups the corpus splits into
top_level_keys.cross_reference_summary: roll-up of every sidecar claim checked against measurement
top_level_keys.corpus_wide_invariants: facts that hold for all 9 indexed media files without exception

corpus.access: READ-ONLY. Nothing in this directory may be moved, renamed, modified, deleted or re-encoded.

files.derived_from: DJI_0355_proxy.mp4, 16.666667-24.966667 s = proxy frames 500-748 inclusive (measured; sidecar declares 16.67)
files.provenance_note: CORRECTED 2026-07-27 (claim C24 killed 2/3 on adversarial verification). Extraction is FRAME-EXACT at proxy frame 500 = 16.666667 s = floor(declared start_time x 30); it did NOT begin one frame late. Pixel PSNR resolves the lag unambiguously: this session measured mean psnr_avg over 60 frames of 18.4002 dB at -ss 16.666667 versus 17.4937 dB at 16.633333 (frame 499) and 17.4959 dB at 16.700000 (frame 501) - a single sharp peak on frame 500. Two independent skeptics reproduced the same peak (28.96 dB @500 vs 22.15/22.16 dB at 501/499; and 27.21 dB vs 22.68/22.69 dB). The superseded '501' figure came from a RAW mean-luma correlation whose top lags span only r=0.99423-0.99706 - a spread too narrow to resolve one frame, and an artefact of the metric. The clip's 249-frame count (vs a 250-frame declared span) is a shortfall at the END of the range, not a late start.

cross_reference.disagreement_explanation: CORRECTED 2026-07-27 (claim C24 killed 2/3). The sidecar rounds start_time to 2 dp (16.67). Extraction began FRAME-EXACTLY at the true 16.666667 s = proxy frame 500 - not one frame late - as PSNR resolves (18.4002 dB at 16.666667 vs 17.4937/17.4959 dB at the two neighbouring frames, this session). The clip holds 249 frames rather than 250 because the range ends one frame short (frames 500-748), which is what the sidecar's own 2 dp rounding produces: 25.0 - 16.67 = 8.33 s; 8.33 x 30 = 249.9; floor = 249. duration_ts 127488 / time_base 15360 = 8.3 exactly, so 8.300 s is the true duration and not a rounding of 8.33. Note the sidecar's own summary.total_duration 53.3 only balances if 8.3 is used, so the sidecar's per-clip 8.33 disagrees with its own summary.

files.derived_from: an absent parent timeline shared with viral_test_v2.mp4; frame-locked sibling, not a resample of it
files.provenance_note: PARTIALLY CORRECTED 2026-07-27 (claim C57 killed 3/3). PSNR between the pair is near-symmetric, but the superseded 31.80 dB figure is not reproducible in either direction. With bicubic BOTH ways: downscaling viral_test_v2_4k to 1080x1920 against viral_test_v2 gives psnr_y 34.640697 dB (two skeptics reproduced 34.64 to 4 s.f. independently); upscaling viral_test_v2 to 2160x3840 gives psnr_y 34.404432 dB (also reproduced twice). The gap is 0.24 dB, not 2.84 dB - so the conclusion that NEITHER file is identifiable as the render source from pixels is STRONGER than originally stated, not weaker. The scaler is load-bearing: a five-scaler sweep spans 33.467-34.714 dB, a 1.25 dB spread five times wider than the corrected 0.24 dB asymmetry, so no PSNR figure here is meaningful without naming it. Detail: native 4K carries more high-frequency energy than any upscale of the 1080 member can, so the pair are frame-locked siblings rather than a resample - direction confirmed, magnitude UNSETTLED. This session measured mean Laplacian (3x3, gray) energy over 61 frames at 3.2991 (native) vs 2.0993 (1080 bicubic-upscaled) = 1.57x; an earlier phase reported 3.2365 vs 1.8853 = 1.72x over 180 frames. Neither figure reproduces the other and the ratio was never entered into the claim set, so it went unverified - treat 1.57-1.72x as a range, not a constant. '4k' names the 3840 LONG (vertical) edge; the frame is 2160 wide.
